_comment: DISABLED TEMPLATE — this request cannot render: status is not 'approved' and owner_approved is false, so the pack fails closed at preflight. To arm one render: copy this file, set status='approved', owner_approved=true, approved_by=<who approved>, approved_at=<iso-utc>, fill the final prompt, and set render_window to the approved window. Stage to gdrive:ada-nest-kk-llm only during an owner-idle window on KK-Mac. Never set adobe_upload to anything but false.
purpose: One bounded SDXL comparison render for the remote-work campaign (comparison-b style baseline exists in gdrive:ada-nest-adobe-stock).
prompt: Photorealistic modern home office workspace, laptop on a wooden desk near a bright window, warm morning light, coffee cup and notebook, shallow depth of field, natural colors, commercial stock photo
negative_prompt: cartoon, illustration, painting, cgi, text, watermark, logo, signature, people, hands, deformed, blurry, oversaturated

model._manifest_contract: request.model must equal $VENV/model-manifest.json {model_id, revision}; the pinned snapshot must already exist on disk (snapshot_dir in the manifest, else ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/models--<id>/snapshots/<revision>). No downloads — mismatch fails closed.
